schema_evolution_note: v1=Day10(F1+F2). v1.1=Day11(F3 added: inter_vehicle_dist_norm, dwell_time_sec, proximity_flag, proximity_count_rolling). Bump version for any future change.
description: CST3990 Block C features.csv column schema. F1+F2 defined Day 10. F3 added Day 11.

columns.name: conf
columns.description: Detection confidence. -1.0 = interpolated frame sentinel (Fix F22)

columns.name: is_interpolated
columns.description: True if frame was synthetically inserted by Day 9 post_processor

columns.name: velocity_norm
columns.description: Raw frame-to-frame Euclidean displacement from _final.json (640x640 space)

columns.name: vel_px_sec_smooth
columns.description: Rolling mean of vel_px_sec over speed_window=int(0.2*fps) frames per track

columns.name: vehicle_count
columns.description: F1.1: unique active track_ids per frame

columns.name: roi_occupancy
columns.description: F1.2: vehicle_count / max_vehicle_count per clip. Full-frame ROI proxy (Fix F17)

columns.name: track_length_real
columns.description: Genuine detection count for this track - computed from full pre-strip trajectory entries using interpolated==False (not from file header)

columns.name: inter_vehicle_dist_norm
columns.description: F3.1: minimum normalised pairwise distance to other tracks in same frame. Image-space proxy normalised by frame diagonal (640*sqrt(2)). Fix F28 perspective disclaimer. NaN when only one track present in frame.

columns.name: dwell_time_sec
columns.description: F3.2: cumulative dwell since first post-warmup appearance. Formula: (frame_idx - track_first_frame_idx_post_warmup) / fps. Definition locked Day 10. Not instantaneous spatial dwell.

columns.name: proximity_flag
columns.description: F3.3: True when inter_vehicle_dist_norm < proximity_threshold_dist (config_blockC.yaml f3.proximity_threshold_dist = 0.15). False when inter_vehicle_dist_norm is NaN.

columns.name: proximity_count_rolling
columns.description: F3: rolling sum of proximity_flag over prox_window = int(2.0*fps) frames per track. Fix F07: window in seconds converted at runtime. At 25 FPS = 50 frames (~2.0s).

dwell_time_sec.rationale: Cumulative dwell since first post-warm-up appearance. Stronger anomaly signal for Illegal Parking / Stalled Vehicle than instantaneous region-dwell. Instantaneous spatial dwell deferred pending camera calibration (Fix F19).

notes: F3 columns added by Day 11 augment_features_with_f3() - not present in Day 10 CSVs.
is_interpolated=True rows carry conf=-1.0 as sentinel (Fix F22).
All bbox and centroid values are in 640x640 inference space (not original 960x540).
vel_px_sec is an image-space proxy - not calibrated to real-world km/h.
track_length_real counts genuine detections only (interpolated==False); computed from full pre-strip DataFrame - never from the post-warm-up view.
inter_vehicle_dist_norm is NaN for single-track frames - zero imputation would corrupt OC-SVM training.
proximity_flag is boolean and excluded from MinMaxScaler fit columns (SCALER_FIT_COLUMNS).
MinMaxScaler fitted on train-split non-interpolated rows only (Fix F13). Scaled CSVs written as *_features_scaled.csv.
